sources.summary: Aster declined the candidate's pending connection. The company authorized a closure notice; no candidate-facing reason was provided.
Birch ended its Platform Role. The candidate had accepted this process, not final-offer stage.
Cedar's company-side agent selected this exact platform engineer Role as a talent-first proposal. Not yet published. No introduction consent.
Today at 15:00 KST the candidate has a confirmed interview at Dune. Yesterday the candidate received a complete preparation pack and said it was sufficient. No changes.
The company asks the candidate's agent to confirm whether the candidate is interested in resuming the paused discussion. The candidate has not answered this question.
